Resubmitted with the numeral form to clear the deterministic check.

**RENEWAL — deviation (fallback target).** § 8.2's 180-day non-renewal notice window fails the 60-day fallback ceiling and is in walk-away territory. Sole operative change: "one hundred eighty days'" → "sixty (60) days'" in § 8.2, so the window now reads as both words and the numeral 60. Element 2 remains already met by § 8.3's lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap, which beats the 5% ceiling. All favourable retained language (12-month term, mutual notice right, 90-day increase notice, no uplift on prepaid periods) is untouched; the preferred limbs (mutual-agreement default, 30-day opt-out, 60-day Vendor reminder) are noted only.
